I thought before there weren’t any good veneer specialists in Thailand. I spent a long time looking for a place that could make veneers that don’t look like chewing gum pads, but have a gradient, a translucent edge, and other details that make them look like natural teeth.

Then a friend showed me Dr. Satorn’s Instagram, and I saw exactly the kind of work I had been searching for. Of course, I reached out to him. I’m really happy with the result!! The teeth turned out exactly the way I wanted. All my wishes were taken into account, and the result is very beautiful and natural-looking, which was super important to me.

And the price was very, very reasonable. It’s actually cheaper than in Russia, but the quality is on par with the best Russian clinics. The doctor himself is kind and pleasant. I can confidently recommend Dr. Sato

Paid an exorbitant amount of 6900 thb per person for scaling polishing, air flow and whitening package. I've been to many dental clinics before, but this is the only one who shoots the water jet directly at the gum, causing intense pain and bleeding during the session. When the nurse made me gargle and spit, chunks of my gum came out. It scared me and the doctor did not even bother explaining. My husband experienced the same and I feel so sorry to have to put him through this. Teeth whitening was so sensitive but they said it's normal. I can't comment about whether this is truly normal, or whether their bleaching agents are too strong for safety. But I know that it is not normal for the water jet to be shot at the gums to cause all my gums to bleed and be worn down. All the other dentists that I go to will only go around the surrounding tissue and I've NEVER felt this pain ever doing scaling and polishing before. Do yourself a favour and don't put yourself through this misery paying so much to go through this pain.
